name: Maebari Teikoku no Gyakushuu
source:
In 200x, humanity is occupied by aliens. But they don't lose their freedom and autonomy, just military is controlled by aliens. Also, aliens in charge of negotiations with humans are very beautiful. 

There is one thing aliens force to humans. That is "Women can only wear Maebari on their lower body."

[Edited from Himeya Shop]
translation:
200X年，人类被外星人占领了。但他们并没有失去自由和自治权，只是军事力量被外星人所掌控。而且，负责与人类谈判的外星人都非常美丽。

外星人对人类施加了一项强制规定，那就是——"女性下半身只能穿戴贴条。"

[改编自Himeya Shop]
